title: epan: Change header files to use #pragma once
description: AI-Assisted: yes [GitHub CoPilot generating Powershell script to do replacement]

notes.body: AI script could have been a little smarter (so I didn't have to do manual changes).  I may update script before trying other folders.

This added UTF-8 BOMs to a bunch of files:

```
% hexdump -C ../epan/ftypes/ftypes-int.h | head -1 
00000000  ef bb bf 2f 2a 2a 20 40  66 69 6c 65 0a 20 2a 0a  |.../** @file. *.|
```

We should probably have a check for that somewhere, e.g. checkAPIs.pl.
Thanks AI!  I'll go the "add to checkAPIs.pl + fix" more than revert.
